summary: Verified new RECOMMEND MARGINS feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: added 4 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_contractor_api.py — small low-risk fencing (cont=7.5, oh=15, profit=25), medium concrete slab (7.5/12/20), large high-risk earthworks+retaining (10/8/15), and empty-items defaults. 19/20 pytest pass (only pre-existing unrelated test_auth_me case-sensitivity failure remains). Frontend: logged in as jane@acme.com.au, Quote Builder opened via FAB (quote-add-button). (1) Medium concrete slab: 1x 'Concrete slab supply & lay 100mm' @ $120/m2 qty=100 (direct $12,000) → tapped recommend-margins-button → contingency-input=7.5, overhead-input=12, profit-input=20; recommendation-text shows 'Medium-risk work → 7.5% contingency · Job size $5k–$20k → 12.0% overheads · 20.0% profit margin for this job size'; quote-breakdown recalculated to Cont $900, OH $1,548, Profit $2,889.60, GST $1,733.76, Final $19,071.36. Overrode profit 20→22, live breakdown updated Final $19,389.22 (Profit 22% $3,178.56). Saved via builder-save → quote Q-0006 'TEST_Recommend_Medium' appears in list with overridden 22% profit persisted. (2) Small low-risk: 12x Plate compactor @ $95/day (direct $1,140) → recommend → cont=7.5, oh=15, profit=25 ✓ rationale 'Low-risk work → 7.5% contingency · Job size small (< $5k) → 15.0% overheads · 25.0% profit'. (3) Large high-risk: 200x Excavator 5T + operator @ $145/hr ($29k, kw 'excavat') + 84x Besser block retaining wall @ $320/m2 ($26.88k, kw 'retain') = direct $55,880 → recommend → cont=10, oh=8, profit=15 ✓ rationale 'High-risk work → 10.0% contingency · Job size $50k–$150k → 8.0% overheads · 15.0% profit'. Regression: quote-detail-view opened for DRAFT quote Q-0006, detail-edit button visible, detail-status-SENT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED status chips present, Contingency (7.5%) line visible in breakdown ($900). Same cosmetic RN-web deprecation warnings persist as prior iterations (shadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: recommendMargins() correctly early-returns when items.length===0; POST /api/recommend-margins body { items } matches RecommendInput schema (backend derives direct_cost from qty*unit_rate when direct_cost not provided).

setContingency/setOverhead/setProfit correctly stringify the numeric response; live preview (/calculate-quote) fires via useEffect when any of these change, so quote-breakdown updates without extra work.
Manual override after recommend works correctly — user typing overwrites the recommendation-driven value, and saveQuote sends the final values (verified Q-0006 saved with overridden profit=22).
Rationale line renders inside recommendBox with testID recommendation-text as spec'd; hidden until first recommendation completes.

Recommend button visibility is unconditional in the JSX (always rendered near Margins), but the handler is a no-op when items empty — matches spec intent ('appears' functionally when there are items).

success_rate.backend: 19/20 (95%) — 1 pre-existing unrelated failure; all 4 new recommend-margins tests pass
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 3 job profiles + override + save + regressions verified

seed_data_creation: Created 'TEST_Recommend_Medium' (Q-0006) via UI as DRAFT with recommended → overridden (profit 22) margins; final $19,389.22. Two additional builder sessions (small low-risk, large high-risk) discarded via builder-close, no persistence side-effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recommend-margins feature fully wired. Flow: builder open → add >=1 line item via add-line-button → recommend-margins-button POSTs /api/recommend-margins with current items → contingency/overhead/profit inputs auto-fill and recommendation-text renders (rationale joined with '·') → quote-breakdown recalculates via /calculate-quote effect → user may override any input → builder-save uses final values. Heuristic (verified): risk from item description keywords {high: earthwork/excavat/retaining/sleeper/soil/tipper/drainage/backfill/footing; medium: concrete/slab/paving/crushed rock; else low}; contingency {low 5, med 7.5, high 10} +2.5 if direct<$2k; overhead/profit by size band (<$5k → 15/25, <$20k → 12/20, <$50k → 10/17.5, <$150k → 8/15, else 6/12).
